# Accessibility audit (WCAG-ish) — Meraki

## Focus
- `app/src/layout/views/layout.tsx:49-51,142` — skip link and `main#conteudo[tabindex=-1]` are present; good baseline.
- `app/static/js/app.js` canvas modal block — modal is a plain `div.canvas-modal` with no `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal`, no focus trap and no focus restoration to trigger; only `Escape`/close button. Tab can reach background.
- `app/static/css/app.css` — no `prefers-reduced-motion` handling anywhere; toast transition (`transition: opacity .2s`) and smooth scroll in `app.js` (`scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" })`) ignore reduced-motion preference.
- `app/static/css/app.css` — disabled controls rely on `opacity: .65` (`.input:disabled`, `.table-done`), reducing focus/contrast affordances.

## Contrast
- `app/static/css/app.css` `:root` — muted tokens (`--muted: #667085` light, `#98a6ba` dark) are used for 11–13px text on tinted surfaces; opacity-based variants (`.table-done`, `.input:disabled`, `.priority-manual`) further lower contrast.
- `app/static/css/app.css` `.calendar-task` — 10px text on `color-mix(accent 14%, surface)` tint; low visual separation for small text.
- `app/static/css/app.css` `.offline-banner` — `background: var(--warning)` with fixed `color: #111`; verify in both schemes (warning token changes in dark mode).
- Docs note no automated contrast testing and no high-contrast theme (`docs/ref/07-arquitetura-comparada.md` §baseline; `docs/ref/06-taiga-frontend.md`).

## ARIA
- `app/src/layout/views/ui.tsx` `Select` (~220–238) — `<select>` has no `aria-describedby`/`aria-invalid`, and error `<span>` has no `id`, so field errors are not programmatically associated (unlike `Field`/`TextArea`).
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/item.tsx` tabs (~162–171) — `role="tablist"/"tab"` with `aria-current`, but no `aria-selected`, no `aria-controls`, and panels are not marked `role="tabpanel"`; behaves as links, not true tabs.
- `app/src/layout/views/layout.tsx` notification bell (~134–138) — `aria-label="Notificações"` is static; `.unread-dot` count is visual only and not announced.
- `app/src/layout/views/layout.tsx` canvas modal (`app.js`) — no dialog semantics/label.
- `app/static/css/app.css` table headers (`.data th`) — no `scope` on `<th>` in views; table semantics could be strengthened.

## Keyboard
- `app/static/js/app.js` — global shortcuts `/` (search) and `c` (new issue) are reasonable and guard typing; `Escape` closes canvas. Good.
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/demands.tsx` tables/cards — no roving tabindex or arrow-key navigation; every link/button is a tab stop, large tab order on full-HD.
- `app/src/layout/views/ui.tsx` composer toolbar buttons (~132–142 in chat) — 30×30 targets, clickable but no keyboard affordance beyond native button; acceptable but small.
- Canvas modal — `Escape` works, but no focus trap and iframe receives focus without modal semantics.

## Target sizes
- `app/static/css/app.css` `.composer-tools button` — `min-height: 30px; min-width: 30px` (below 44px common target).
- `app/static/css/app.css` `.btn-small` — `min-height: 34px`.
- `app/static/css/app.css` `.input-compact` — `min-height: 28px`.
- `app/static/css/app.css` `.chip button` — no minimum size; small hit area.
- `app/static/css/app.css` `.calendar-task` — tiny blocks with no minimum touch target.

## Screen reader / live regions
- `app/src/layout/views/layout.tsx` toast (`aria-live="polite"`), `app/src/layout/views/chat.tsx` message list/preview (`aria-live="polite"`) — good.
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/projects.tsx` success alert (~40) and `app/src/modules/demands/views/item.tsx` archived alert — alerts without `role="alert"/"status"`; inconsistent with `auth.tsx`/`tags.tsx`.
- `app/src/layout/views/ui.tsx` `Empty` — no `role="status"`/live region; non-critical.
- `app/src/layout/views/ui.tsx` `AttachmentList` archive button is `button.link.danger` with text; okay but small.

## Overall
Baseline is decent (skip link, focus-visible, semantic forms, aria-live in chat/toast, labels on filters), but gaps concentrate in canvas modal dialog semantics/focus management, `Select` error association, tab semantics, small touch targets, reduced-motion support, and inconsistent alert roles.
